title: Back-Action-Evading Measurements and Quantum Non-Demolition Variables via Linear Systems Engineering
summary: We establish a framework for realizing back-action-evading (BAE) measurements and quantum non-demolition (QND) variables in linear quantum systems. The key condition, a purely imaginary Hamiltonian with a real or imaginary coupling operator, enables BAE measurements of conjugate observables. Symmetric coupling further yields QND variables. For non-compliant systems, coherent feedback can engineer BAE measurements.
